script: Isso acabou de acontecer na ciência e tecnologia: NASA’s ISAM State of Play: The Industry Standard for Space Servicing, Assembly, and Manufacturing. De acordo com relatórios publicados pela NASA News, os novos dados confirmam: When companies began approaching NASA’s Langley Research Center, asking to be included in the In-Space Servicing, Assembly, and Manufacturing (ISAM) State of Play for access to competitive intelligence, the team knew they had crossed an inflection point. “We’ve had some unnamed companies ask if we have any proprietary information,” says Dale Arney, senior team lead […]. Isso muda completamente o cenário porque abre portas para aplicações que antes pareciam distantes. Acompanhe o canal para as próximas atualizações desta história.
